study: F3 WP3.1-R: materiality of the force-model terms production lacks (REQ-DYN-007), synthetic survey with a linear OD-impact rule (analysis only, no production change)
written: 2026-11-07, before any survey number. The only computation before this file was an infrastructure check: SPICE coverage (sxform J2000->ITRF93, MOON_PA_DE440, SSB states, Venus/Jupiter positions, GM values) at the planned epochs
base: origin/main 4d8819a (independent of the F2 stack #109-#114: no measurement or estimator change of that stack is used)
question: Which force terms, absent from the production force model, bias this project's OD by at least 0.1 sigma on a production synthetic arc?
requirement: REQ-DYN-007; findings DYN-06 (lunar solid tide), DYN-07 (lunar albedo / IR), DYN-08 (Earth shadow), DYN-09 (1PN), DYN-17 (Sun direction without light time in SRP / shadow), DYN-19 (Earth J2 frame = identity); the C7 planets item

prior_evidence.C7: studies/phase17/reports/phase_c7_dynamics_candidates_survey.md: on the LRO arc (linear about F2p) the tide is MATERIAL (47.5 m, share 0.64 of the 263 gap, K 0.0745 -> 0.0395); 1PN 0.10 m and Venus+Jupiter 0.0003 m immaterial. C7-I (nonlinear refit) has gates G_OFF/G_LIN PASS, no refit result on record
prior_evidence.C6: studies/phase17/reports/phase_c6_lunar_radiation_survey.md: C6_NOT_QUALIFIED (G_QUAD of the linear quadrature failed in three runs); lunar radiation 2.06e-8 m/s^2 RMS at K 0.010, 0.60 of SRP on the sunlit part
prior_evidence.why_again: C6/C7 measured on the real LRO arc with study-specific linearisations. This survey decides REQ-DYN-007 for production synthetic arcs with one predeclared rule, the production force model and the production measurement Jacobians. It uses nonlinear trajectory differences, so C6's quadrature problem does not arise

baseline_dynamics.rhs: the production 6-state RHS that dynamics.propagate_state integrates (dynamics._build_state_rhs): point-mass Moon, Earth and Sun third body from the production Moon-centred ephemeris providers (ephemeris.sample_moon_centered_ephemeris, 60 s grid, 600 s margin each side), cannonball SRP K_SRP = 0.010 m^2/kg (KP2 K0) with the CONICAL_PENUMBRA lunar shadow, shadow_events False
baseline_dynamics.off: lunar J2 and harmonics, Earth J2 (the ScenarioConfig defaults j2_moon = 0, enable_lunar_harmonics False, enable_earth_j2 False)
baseline_dynamics.integrator: scipy solve_ivp DOP853, rtol 1e-12, atol 1e-13, t_eval on the arc grid (the production solve_ivp branch of propagate_state with method='DOP853')
baseline_dynamics.with_term: the same closure plus scale * [0, 0, 0, a_term(t, x)], scale = 1 (survey) or 0 (G2); every term is added alone to the same baseline

terms.TIDE: elastic solid tide of the Moon raised by the Earth and the Sun, degrees 2 and 3: sum over B in {Earth, Sun}, n in {2, 3} of k_n grad[GM_B R^(2n+1) / (d_B^(n+1) r^(n+1)) P_n(cos psi_B)] (studies/phase17/scripts/phase_c7_dynamics_candidates.tide_acceleration), k2 = 0.024223, k3 = 0.0163, R = 1738 km (GL1800F label lines 31-34), GM_B from the baseline, d_B from the baseline providers. The full tide (permanent + time-varying), as C7
terms.LRP: lunar albedo + thermal-IR pressure on the cannonball: K_LRP * phase_c6_lunar_radiation.acceleration_kernel (albedo 0.12, emissivity 0.95, night 100 K, Gauss-Legendre cap 60 x 72), K_LRP = K_SRP = 0.010 m^2/kg (one cannonball), Sun from the baseline provider
terms.EARTH_SHADOW: a_SRP(production, lunar shadow) * (nu_E - 1); nu_E = srp.illumination_fraction(r_sc, r_sun, r_earth, R_E) with R_E = 6378137 m (WGS-84 equatorial), nu_E = 1 when the spacecraft is on the sunward side of the plane through the Earth's centre normal to the Sun direction. Geometric positions; the two occulters combined by multiplication (independent-occulter approximation)
terms.PN: Schwarzschild term of the Moon (IERS 2010 eq. 10.12 without Lense-Thirring and de Sitter, gamma = beta = 1): phase_c7_dynamics_candidates.pn_acceleration with GM_moon of the baseline
terms.PLANETS: Venus and the Jupiter barycentre as third bodies (indirect form, phase_c7_dynamics_candidates.third_body_acceleration), positions spkpos(name, et0 + t, 'J2000', 'NONE', 'MOON'), GM from gm_de440.tpc (bodvrd)
terms.SRP_LIGHT_TIME: a_LT - a_SRP(production). a_LT = K_SRP P(d) nu_LT [(1 - v.u/c) u - v/c] (first order in v/c, Poynting-Robertson form): u and d from the Sun's emission position r_sun - v_sun tau (tau = |r_sc - r_sun| / c) to the spacecraft; nu_LT = srp.illumination_fraction with the Moon at its ray-crossing position -v_moon delta (delta = |r_sc| / c); v = v_sc + v_moon - v_sun; v_moon, v_sun = SSB velocities (spkezr at et0 + t). The Moon-centred frame is the J2000-parallel frame at the Moon's position at t
terms.EARTH_J2: indirect Earth J2 with the epoch's pole: force_models.body_j2_acceleration(r_sc - r_E) - body_j2_acceleration(-r_E), J2_EARTH_UNNORMALIZED, R_EARTH_J2_REF_M, rotation pxform('J2000', 'ITRF93', et0 + t). Reported also: its pole-only part (minus the same with the identity rotation production uses, dynamics._J2000_TO_EARTH_BF)

epochs.E1_NOMINAL: t0 = str2et('2027-03-02T00:00:00') (UTC), the WP2.7 survey epoch; no eclipse
epochs.E2_ECLIPSE_TOTAL: t0 = t_ge - 43200 s, t_ge the greatest eclipse near 2026-03-03 (total lunar eclipse)
epochs.E3_ECLIPSE_PARTIAL: t0 = t_ge - 43200 s, t_ge the greatest eclipse near 2026-08-28 (partial lunar eclipse)
epochs.t_ge_rule: the epoch that minimises the angle between the geocentric Moon direction and the anti-Sun direction (geometric DE440 positions, Earth-centred J2000), on a 60 s grid from 00:00 UTC of the day before to 00:00 UTC of the day after the named date, refined by bounded scalar minimisation (+/- 60 s around the grid minimum) to 1 s

orbits.frame: Moon-centred J2000; p = MOON_PA_DE440 z-axis in J2000 at t0; s = unit Sun direction from the Moon at t0
orbits.O1_POLAR_BETA0: orbit normal n = unit(p x s): polar, the Sun in the orbit plane (longest lunar-shadow passes)
orbits.O2_POLAR_BETA90: n = unit(s - (s.p) p): polar terminator orbit, no lunar shadow
orbits.initial_state: circular, altitude 100 km above R_MOON_M (r0 = 1837.4 km); r0_hat = unit(n x p) if |n x p| > 0.1 else unit(n x x_J2000); v0 = sqrt(GM_moon / r0) (n x r0_hat)

population.arc: 1 day: t = 0 to 86400 s every 60 s (1441 epochs)
population.stations: Goldstone DSN, Madrid DSN, Canberra DSN (config.range_rate_stations())
population.visibility: a row for every station and grid epoch in the raw production mask (visibility.analyze_visibility_gap_with_transforms on the baseline trajectory with sample_j2000_to_itrf93_transforms: elevation >= 10 deg, line of sight clear of the Moon); no gap filling

measurements: production instantaneous geometric range and range-rate (measurements.compute_range_rate_residuals_analytic on a PassGeometry built from the baseline providers and transforms): values for the signature, local 4x6 H_tilde blocks for the design. The terms change the trajectory, not the observable model, so the instantaneous model carries their signature

od_impact.design: H = H_tilde [Phi(t, t0) | dx/dK] with Phi and dx/dK from production dynamics.propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity (DOP853, rtol 1e-12, atol 1e-13) along the baseline
od_impact.signature: delta_y = y(x_term) - y(x_baseline) per row, nonlinear, from the production measurement values on the two trajectories
od_impact.prior: diag(100 m, 100 m, 100 m, 0.1 m/s, 0.1 m/s, 0.1 m/s)^2 on x0 (KP2 PRIOR_SD), none on K_SRP
od_impact.estimate: delta_theta = argmin |W^(1/2) (delta_y - H delta_theta)|^2 + |P0^(-1/2) delta_x0|^2, solved by QR of the stacked whitened design (the normal matrix is not formed)
od_impact.sigma: sqrt(diag((H^T W H + P0inv)^-1)) from the same QR factor
od_impact.response: max over the 7 parameters of |delta_theta_i / sigma_i|
od_impact.information: max |delta_r(t)| over the arc (m); max |delta_y| per observable; post-fit signature |W^(1/2) (delta_y - H delta_theta)| RMS in sigma units; the acceleration RMS and maximum along the baseline

materiality_rule.od_material: a term is OD_MATERIAL if, in some cell, design and noise level, max_i |delta_theta_i / sigma_i| >= 0.1 (the C1 threshold)
materiality_rule.decision: IMPLEMENT (to WP3.2, its own predeclaration; defaults stay an owner decision) if OD_MATERIAL, DOCUMENT_ONLY otherwise (the measured bound goes to docs/assurance/assumptions-and-limits.md). EARTH_SHADOW is zero outside eclipses by construction; its decision is taken on E2/E3 and reads 'eclipse arcs'
materiality_rule.gate_veto: a failed gate makes the outcome of the affected terms WP3_1_INCONCLUSIVE (see reject_if)

gates.G1_UNIT: tests/test_wp3_1_force_terms.py passes before the survey runs: (a) EARTH_SHADOW: nu_E = 0 on the anti-Sun axis 384400 km behind the Earth, 1 on the sunward side and far off the axis, continuous and monotone across the penumbra along a line normal to the axis (no step > 0.01 between 1 km samples); the term equals -a_SRP where nu_E = 0 and is exactly 0 where nu_E = 1; (b) SRP_LIGHT_TIME: with c = infinity the term is <= 1e-15 |a_SRP|; with v perpendicular to u the aberration part equals -K P nu v / c to 1e-12 relative, with v along u the magnitude factor is (1 - v/c) to 1e-12; displacing the occulter by -v delta moves a spacecraft on the geometric umbra boundary to the side the displacement predicts; (c) EARTH_J2: with the identity rotation each of its two parts equals an independent closed-form zonal J2 acceleration (test implementation) to 1e-12 relative, and the term equals the production difference f3body_moon(j2_earth = J2_EARTH_UNNORMALIZED) - f3body_moon(j2_earth = 0) to 1e-14 m/s^2 absolute (the rounding of two ~1.45 m/s^2 sums); the ITRF93 pole is within 20 arcsec of the IAU 2006 precession angle theta_A(T) from the J2000 pole; (d) TIDE, LRP, PN, PLANETS: tests/test_phase_c7_dynamics_candidates.py and tests/test_phase_c6_lunar_radiation.py pass, and the survey wrappers pass the declared parameters (k2, k3, R, K_LRP, model fields)
gates.G2_NULL: every term with scale 0 reproduces the baseline trajectory bit for bit, every cell
gates.G3_PARITY: the survey baseline equals production dynamics.propagate_state(method='DOP853', srp = SRPOptions(K_SRP), rtol 1e-12, atol 1e-13) bit for bit at every grid epoch, every cell
gates.G4_FLOOR: max position difference between the baseline at (1e-12, 1e-13) and at (1e-13, 1e-14) <= 1e-3 m in every cell; a term whose max |delta_r| is below 10 x its cell's floor is reported BELOW_FLOOR (its delta_theta / sigma is still reported)
gates.G5_DESIGN: in cell O1 x E1 every design column (6 state + K, range and range-rate rows) agrees with central finite differences of production propagation + measurement (steps 1 m, 1e-3 m/s, 1e-4 m^2/kg) to <= 1e-4 relative (column 2-norm)
gates.G6_ECLIPSE: the Moon centre has nu_E = 0 (umbra) at some grid epoch of E2, nu_E < 0.5 at some grid epoch of E3, and nu_E = 1 at every grid epoch of E1 (same EARTH_SHADOW geometry evaluated at the Moon centre)

expectations: stated before the run, not gates: TIDE and LRP OD_MATERIAL (C7 47.5 m on LRO; C6 LRP 0.60 of SRP); EARTH_SHADOW material on E2/E3 only; PN (~1e-10 m/s^2), PLANETS (~1e-12), EARTH_J2 (tidal part ~3e-11) and SRP_LIGHT_TIME (~1e-4 of SRP, lunar-shadow contacts ~0.1 s) DOCUMENT_ONLY
out_of_scope: box-wing / panel SRP (needs the LRO macro-model and attitude; WP3.4); the atmosphere's ~2 % enlargement of the Earth's umbra and the light-time displacement of the Earth's shadow (~38 km at the Moon, contacts ~40 s), refinements for WP3.2 if EARTH_SHADOW is implemented; the Earth's shadow on the lunar surface in LRP (LRP is overestimated during the umbral phase of E2/E3); Earth albedo / IR on the spacecraft (~1e-12 m/s^2); lunar de Sitter and Lense-Thirring (~1e-11 m/s^2); lagged or frequency-dependent tide; lunar gravity beyond the point mass in the baseline; the LRO arc (C6/C7) and the C7-I refit; any production change
reject_if: G1 fails for a term -> that term WP3_1_INCONCLUSIVE; G2, G3 or G5 fails -> every term WP3_1_INCONCLUSIVE; G4 fails in a cell -> the terms with max |delta_r| < 100 x that cell's floor are WP3_1_INCONCLUSIVE in that cell; G6 fails -> EARTH_SHADOW WP3_1_INCONCLUSIVE. Any change after a result goes to docs/assurance/amendment-log.md and the result is exploratory
agent_decisions: agent decisions, owner approval pending: (1) synthetic production arcs, not the LRO arc; (2) box-wing SRP deferred to WP3.4; (3) base origin/main, independent of the F2 stack

amendments.before_any_result: yes: found while writing tests/test_wp3_1_force_terms.py, before any test, gate or survey number existed
amendments.gate: G1_UNIT (b), the case v along u
amendments.was: with v along u the magnitude factor is (1 - v/c) to 1e-12
amendments.now: with v along u (no Sun or Moon motion), a_LT = (1 - 2 v/c) a_SRP to 1e-12 relative
amendments.why: the declared a_LT = K P nu [(1 - v.u/c) u - v/c] gives (1 - v/c) u - (v/c) u = (1 - 2 v/c) u for v = v u: the Doppler factor of the incident flux and the aberration term each contribute -v/c along u (Poynting-Robertson; Burns, Lamy & Soter 1979, Icarus 40, eq. 2). The formula is unchanged; the old test statement contradicted it
amendments.status: the survey stays confirmatory; recorded in docs/assurance/amendment-log.md

amendments.before_any_result: no: after a gate result. Before the survey, an integrator diagnostic with no force term measured the G4 floor of cell O1 x E1 under the predeclared profile (one DOP853 solve_ivp run, shadow_events False) at 1.434 m over the 1-day arc, so G4 fails there as predeclared (> 1e-3 m); O2 x E1: 1.9e-5 m. Under production's consistent profile (PropagationProfile(): DOP853, shadow_events True) the O1 x E1 floor is 6.0e-5 m, and 2.1e-5 m with the shadow switched off (NO_SHADOW). A 1-h smoke run of O1 x E1 (software check, all terms, both profiles) was also seen: under the predeclared profile the G5 K_SRP column misses by 0.17 (state columns 4e-5 to 3e-4); under D2 the state columns agree to 2e-7 and the K_SRP column to 1.7e-4 (range) and 1.7e-5 (range rate) over that hour
amendments.cause: the kink of the conical lunar-shadow acceleration at each penumbra contact falls inside integrator steps (Phase D1: 0.1-1.9 m per ~1.2-day arc; D2 added event segmentation for this reason). O1 (beta 0) and O3 cross the lunar shadow about 24 times a day
amendments.change: a second full run under profile D2: every propagation of the survey (baseline, term runs, G3's production reference propagate_state(..., method='DOP853', shadow_events=True), G4, the K-sensitivity run, G5's finite differences) uses production's event segmentation: dynamics._shadow_contact_times on the RHS being integrated (a term run is cut at its own trajectory's contacts) and dynamics._integrate_segmented with _shadow_contact_check. Terms, cells, designs, noise levels, prior, gates, thresholds and the materiality rule are unchanged
amendments.not_cut: SRP_LIGHT_TIME moves the lunar-shadow contacts by ~0.1 s; its own kinks are not cut (an impulse of ~5e-9 m/s per contact)
amendments.both_reported: the predeclared run (profile P0) is also run in full and reported as computed: studies/phase17/results/wp3_1_materiality_survey.json; the D2 run: studies/phase17/results/wp3_1_materiality_survey_a2.json. The G4 values of the two runs reproduce the diagnostic's O1 x E1 floors
amendments.status: exploratory (keşifsel): a change after a gate result. Closing REQ-DYN-007 on the D2 decisions is an owner decision
